Strategy: Keep the winning band edges but weaken the reward to ten, testing whether a gentler bonus still beats Best Fit without overriding tight fits. It may help by nudging rather than forcing the band, but may fail if the bonus becomes too small to matter.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (10 if r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 42 else 0) - (25 if r - item >= 6 and r - item <= 20 else 0) for r in bins]
```
